text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Right, I must make sure to exercise 
restraint today! I've been slacking off a 
bit lately, after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Should I stick to the same dietary 
restrictions as yesterday... No, perhaps 
something even stricter would be better?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
M-My skin... It looks slightly duller than 
usual, I dare say...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
E-Even without guessing, it's obviously 
because of my dietary restrictions, isn't 
it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... I simply cannot appear before 
others in such a state..."

Her skin condition worsened due to 
excessive dieting, leaving Mejiro McQueen 
feeling down in the dumps.
